title: Extension 2: Balloons & Rocket (For Unit 6)
content:
Characters playing games and laughing with balloons.

"Ha! Ha!"; "Let's make a balloon rocket!"

Balloons are more than toys or decorations. Do you know we can make a rocket with them? It is easy!

a balloon; a peg; a piece of string; a drinking straw; some tape; two chairs

Put a piece of string through the drinking straw.; Place two chairs about five metres apart. Tie the string to the chairs.; Blow up the balloon. Use a peg to keep the air inside it.; Stick the balloon to the drinking straw with some tape.; Remove the peg and watch your balloon rocket fly!
